Role Overview:

The Strategic Project Lead, Finance will oversee high-impact financial initiatives, ensuring alignment with strategic objectives and operational execution. This role requires translating financial data into actionable insights to drive decision-making across the organization. Required Skills & Qualifications:

• Minimum 7 years of experience in finance, accounting, or financial project management.
• Proficiency in financial modeling, Excel, and ERP systems.
• Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex financial data.
• Experience leading cross-functional teams and managing stakeholders.
• Knowledge of GAAP, IFRS, or other relevant accounting standards.

This role offers a unique opportunity to work with a global leader in the Technology, Information and Internet industry, contributing to the modernization of financial infrastructure. The position involves hands-on leadership in high-stakes projects that directly impact the company’s growth trajectory.

jobs.description:
Biospecimen Project Manager (FSP)

ICON plc is a world-leading healthcare intelligence and clinical research organization. We’re proud to foster an inclusive environment driving innovation and excellence, and we welcome you to join us on our mission to shape the future of clinical development.

As a Project Manager, Laboratory at ICON, you will design and analyze clinical trials, interpreting complex medical data, and contribute to the advancement of innovative treatments and therapies.

What You Will Do

Your focus will be on coordinating project and programme management delivery, resolving issues, and developing team capability.

Key Responsibilities Include

Ensure client satisfaction by acting as the Sponsor's main contact person in all matters regarding ICON services including the day-to-day management of studies.
Attend and represent ICON at Sponsor meetings.
Manage 10-15 studies in accordance with Good Clinical Practice.
Communicate with Sponsor's study progress in a responsible and professional manner and provide Sponsors with regular management reports.
Provide ICOLAB support to sponsor personnel.

Your Profile

You will have solid project and programme management experience, with the ability to manage competing priorities and develop your team.

Required Qualifications And Experience

Bachelor's degree in a relevant field such as life sciences or healthcare.
Previous experience in project management within a laboratory or clinical research setting.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to represent the company at sponsor meetings.
Ability to manage multiple studies concurrently while ensuring adherence to regulatory standards and guidelines.
Detail-oriented with strong organizational skills to effectively manage study documentation and timelines.

What ICON Can Offer You

Our success depends on the quality of our people. That’s why we’ve made it a priority to build a diverse culture that rewards high performance and nurtures talent.

In addition to your competitive salary, ICON offers a range of additional benefits. Our benefits are designed to be competitive within each country and are focused on well-being and work life balance opportunities for you and your family.

Our Benefits Examples Include

Competitive retirement planning offerings to maximize savings and plan with confidence for the years ahead.
Global Employee Assistance Programme, LifeWorks, offering 24-hour access to a global network of over 80,000 independent specialized professionals who are there to support you and your family’s well-being.
Life assurance
Flexible country-specific optional benefits, including childcare vouchers, bike purchase schemes, discounted gym memberships, subsidized travel passes, health assessments, among others.

jobs.description:
Über Atos

Atos ist die Marke der Atos Group für KI-gestützte, sichere und ganzheitliche digitale Services. Atos entwirft, entwickelt und betreibt kritische digitale Umgebungen, die Leistungsfähigkeit, Ausfallsicherheit und Souveränität fördern. So unterstützt Atos öffentliche und private Organisationen weltweit dabei, die Kontrolle über ihre Daten und IT-Infrastrukturen zu bewahren und gleichzeitig regulatorische Anforderungen zu erfüllen.

Mit mehr als 54.000 Mitarbeitenden betreut Atos über 4.500 Kunden in 54 Ländern, und unterstützt sie bei der Modernisierung ihrer zentralen IT-Systeme, der Beschleunigung ihrer Cloud- und Datentransformation, der Stärkung ihrer Cybersicherheit sowie der Bereitstellung sicherer digitaler Arbeitsplatzlösungen – zum Nutzen seiner Kunden, ihrer Mitarbeitenden und der Gesellschaft. Darüber hinaus bietet Atos unter der Marke Atos Amplify Beratungsleistungen an.

Als vertrauenswürdiger Partner beim Betrieb komplexer und geschäftskritischer Umgebungen unterstützt Atos Organisationen in stark regulierten und souveränen Kontexten.

Über die Atos Group

Die Atos Group ist ein weltweit führender Anbieter im Bereich der digitalen Transformation. Mit ca. 56.000 Mitarbeitenden und einem Jahresumsatz von ca. 7,2 Mrd. EUR (auf Basis des künftigen Unternehmenszuschnitts) agiert das Unternehmen in 54 Ländern unter zwei Marken Atos für Services und Eviden für Produkte und Systeme. Als europäische Nummer eins in der Cybersicherheit und führend im Bereich Cloud arbeitet die Atos Group für eine sichere und dekarbonisierte Zukunft und bietet maßgeschneiderte KI-gestützte End-to-End Lösungen für alle Branchen. Atos Group ist an der Euronext Paris notiert.

Wir suchen neue Kolleg innen an unseren bundesweiten Standorten.

Unser SAP-Team besteht im deutschsprachigen Raum aus langjährig erfahrenen SAP-Beratern, die branchenübergreifend Transformationsprojekte und -programme im SAP S4/HANA Umfeld planen, umsetzen und betreiben. Als Project Manager verantwortest Du die vertragliche und fachliche Führung unserer SAP-Public-Cloud-Projekte und steuerst unsere internationalen Projektteams. In dieser Rolle bist Du verantwortlich für das Erreichen der Projektziele, den Projekterfolg und die Zufriedenheit unserer Kunden.

Das sind Deine Aufgaben

Du trägst die unternehmerische Verantwortung für die fachliche Führung großer SAP-Projekte im Bereich S/4HANA Cloud, Public Edition und unterstützt und begleitest den Kunden bei der Einführung der SAP-Standard-Prozesse und Best-Practice
Du führst fachlich die Projektteams oder Teilprojekte in einem Multiprojekt-Umfeld
Du verantwortest das Erreichen der Projektziele in Zeit, Budget und Qualität, den Projekterfolg und die Zufriedenheit des Kunden
Planung, Leitung und Ressourcensteuerung sowie Monitoring des Projektfortschritts, Erstellung von Statusberichten, Prüfung und laufende Überwachung definierter Projektkennzahlen in allen Phasen des Projektes sowie die Dokumentation vorhandener Projektergebnisse und -erfahrungen, Nachbetrachtung und / oder Lessons Learned zu Projektabschluss gehören ebenfalls zu Deinen Aufgaben
Zudem coachst Du die Beteiligten im Projekt hinsichtlich der Anwendung von Projektmanagementprozessen und Methoden
Auch in der Kundenakquise und bei Presales-Aktivitäten (Angebotserstellung, Sales Pitches, Ausschreibungen, Messen) ist Deine Unterstützung und Expertise gefragt
Du erweiterst beständig Dein Fachwissen, bildest Junioren aus und trägst damit zum Wissenstransfer in unserer Organisation bei

Das bringst Du mit

Abgeschlossenes Studium in der Fachrichtung Betriebswirtschaft, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Informatik oder vergleichbare praktische Erfahrung
Du verfügst über mindestens 6 Jahre Erfahrung im klassischen SAP-Projektgeschäft und besitzt eine PMP- Zertifizierung oder Vergleichbares
Du verfügst über erste Projektmanagementerfahrung in der SAP S/4HANA Cloud, Public Edition (idealerweise mit entsprechender Zertifizierung)
Du besitzt sehr gute Kenntnisse der gängigen Beratungs- und Projektmanagement-Methoden und –Tools, speziell im SAP-Umfeld, insbesondere bist Du mit SAP Activate als Methodik für S/4 HANA Public Cloud Implementierungen sowie Cloud ALM vertraut. Zudem hast Du Dich bereits mit agilen Projektvorgehensweisen wie z. B. SCRUM beschäftigt und idealerweise in Deinen Projekten eingesetzt
Ausgeprägte Präsentationsfähigkeiten, Verhandlungsgeschick sowie Prozesswissen und Branchen Knowhow (z. B. Manufacturing, Automotive) sind für diese Aufgabe genauso wichtig, wie Kommunikationsfähigkeit, Kundenorientierung und Erfahrung in der Vertragsgestaltung
Mit verhandlungssicheren Deutsch- und Englischkenntnissen bist Du ein kompetenter Ansprechpartner für unsere Kunden
Persönlich überzeugst Du durch Initiative, Entscheidungsfähigkeit, Ergebnisorientierung, Organisationsgeschick, Durchsetzungsfähigkeit sowie Teamfähigkeit
Du bringst Reisebereitschaft mit

Welo Data, a Welo Global brand, is the multilingual data and evaluation partner for foundation labs and enterprises deploying GenAI systems globally. They deliver the human judgment, data infrastructure, and evaluation systems that ensure AI models perform reliably across languages, cultures, and real-world contexts, at every stage from training through deployment.  Its global network of 500,000+ vetted experts spans 300+ languages and locales, enabling high-quality multilingual data creation and structured model evaluation across the full spectrum of modern AI applications — from large language models and voice and speech systems to agentic workflows and robotics and embodied AI. This breadth of linguistic, cultural, and domain expertise enables Welo Data to address critical AI development challenges, including safety, bias, inclusivity, and cross-lingual reliability. A unified global operating model, led by specialized program and quality experts and grounded in assessment-driven talent selection, localized rubrics, and continuous calibration, ensures consistent performance across languages, domains, and modalities. Underpinning all of this is NIMO™ (Network Identity Management and Operations), Welo Data's proprietary identity and fraud-prevention framework. jobs.title: Project Manager Scrum Master
jobs.description:
Job Description: Technology Project Manager / Scrum Master
Location: [Pune]
Position Overview
The Technology Project Manager / Scrum Master is a hands-on delivery leader responsible for establishing disciplined Scrum practices, configuring and governing Jira, and leading complex, cross-functional technology projects across Cordance Commerce
. This role creates the operating rhythm, delivery visibility, risk management, and stakeholder alignment needed to turn strategic priorities and product roadmaps into predictable outcomes.
The ideal candidate combines deep Scrum mastery with strong technology project-management experience
and sufficient technical fluency to coordinate software, data, infrastructure, platform, release, and customer-migration initiatives. This role does not replace Product or Engineering ownership; it enables those teams to work effectively by improving backlog readiness, facilitation, transparency, dependency management, decisions, and execution discipline.
Key Responsibilities
Establish, coach, and continuously improve practical Scrum ways of working across assigned teams
, including roles, working agreements, Definition of Ready, Definition of Done, estimation, capacity planning, sprint goals, and team-level metrics.
Set up and configure Jira from the ground up
, including projects, issue types, workflows, statuses, screens, fields, permissions, boards, filters, dashboards, automation rules, notifications, releases, and reporting conventions.
Serve as the operating owner for Jira data quality and governance, ensuring that teams consistently maintain accurate priorities, owners, estimates, sprint assignments, dependencies, due dates, releases, and status information.
Plan, schedule, and facilitate Scrum ceremonies, including backlog refinement, sprint planning, daily Scrum, sprint review, retrospective, and cross-team Scrum-of-Scrums or dependency forums where needed
.
Coach Product Owners, Engineering leaders, and delivery teams on backlog health, story quality, acceptance criteria, estimation, sustainable commitments, flow, accountability, and continuous improvement.
Remove or escalate impediments, protect sprint commitments from unplanned disruption, and help teams address recurring delivery constraints without creating unnecessary process overhead.
Develop and publish concise weekly delivery reports covering sprint goals, planned-versus-completed work, milestone health, delivery confidence, throughput or velocity trends, blockers, risks, dependencies, decisions, scope changes, and actions requiring leadership attention.
Lead end-to-end planning and execution for strategic technology projects, including platform consolidation, Secure Retail-to-Solutions migration, database modernization, unified reporting, reliability improvements, integrations, and AI-enabled initiatives.
Translate approved business priorities and product roadmaps into project charters, workstreams, milestones, dependencies, resource plans, delivery forecasts, measurable acceptance criteria, and clear ownership.
Establish and maintain integrated project plans across Engineering, Product, Architecture, Data, Quality, Infrastructure, Customer Success, Support, Sales, and external partners.
Facilitate project kickoffs, planning sessions, weekly execution reviews, risk and dependency reviews, decision forums, retrospectives, and executive status updates.
Track scope, schedule, capacity, budget, quality, risks, assumptions, issues, dependencies, decisions, and changes; escalate early with context, business impact, options, and a recommendation.
Coordinate release and migration readiness across technical and customer-facing teams, including validation, cutover, rollback, communications, training, support preparedness, and post-launch stabilization.
Partner with Product Managers and Engineering leaders to maintain clear priorities, healthy and ready backlogs, realistic commitments, and alignment among customer needs, architecture requirements, capacity, and delivery timelines.
Manage vendor and contractor deliverables when assigned, including statements of work, milestones, invoices, risks, performance, and expected return on investment.

Core Competencies
Scrum Leadership:
Applies Scrum deeply and pragmatically, coaches teams and leaders, and builds self-managing teams rather than simply scheduling ceremonies.
Jira Architecture & Governance:

Interface directly with our clients.

5+ years of progressive engineering and project management experience

Proficient knowledge of MS Office Suite (Word, Excel, Access, PowerPoint)

Master’s degree in Civil, Water Resources, or Environmental Engineering
Project or task management experience

Experience in serving various clients involving a wide variety of fields including wastewater, stormwater, and site civil

jobs.description:
1. About NationBuilding Foundation of India

India has made significant progress, but its growth continues to create new challenges and opportunities for change. The NationBuilding Foundation of India (NBFI) believes NationBuilding can be a shared purpose that enables people to take responsibility, contribute meaningfully, and drive positive change.

NBFI is envisioned as a “do-tank” rather than simply a think tank, creating platforms that turn ideas, ambition, and intent into action. Its work spans building engaged citizens, enabling high-capability talent to contribute, addressing priority-sector challenges with industry practitioners, and engaging with leaders, policymakers, and government institutions on policy and implementation.

NBFI's initial focus is on three areas that can strengthen India's long-term capabilities:
● Building India: Campus Initiatives: Creating platforms for young people to engage with important issues, build capabilities, and contribute to NationBuilding.
● The India Healthspan Project: Improving population health through stronger preventive health and enabling people to remain healthier for longer.
● Advancing Scientific Research in India: Strengthening India's scientific research ecosystem and its ability to generate, support, and translate knowledge into meaningful outcomes.

2. About the Role

NBFI is looking for a highly motivated and capable Program Manager to drive the design, development, and execution of initiatives that contribute to NationBuilding. The role will involve working across the organisation's priority areas, translating ideas into well-structured programs, managing execution, and working with a diverse set of stakeholders to deliver meaningful outcomes. The Program Manager will have significant ownership and will be expected to combine strategic thinking with strong execution. The role will involve understanding complex problems, developing practical approaches, coordinating across stakeholders, and ensuring that initiatives move from intent to action.
a. Key Responsibilities

● Lead the planning, development, and execution of NBFI programs and initiatives from concept through implementation.
● Lead and manage large, diverse teams to deliver programs and initiatives effectively.
● Set clear objectives, priorities, roles, and deliverables for teams, and ensure strong execution against them.
● Build high-performing teams by providing direction, mentoring team members, and fostering a culture of ownership and accountability.
● Translate strategic objectives into clear work plans, milestones, and measurable outcomes.
● Identify and resolve operational and execution challenges, making decisions to keep programs on track.
● Conduct research and analysis to understand issues, identify opportunities, and inform program design.
● Build and manage relationships with relevant stakeholders, including young professionals, academic institutions, industry practitioners, researchers, policymakers, and other organisations.
● Coordinate with internal and external teams to ensure effective and timely delivery of initiatives. ● Track program progress, identify challenges, and take corrective action where required.
● Develop presentations, reports, briefs, and other communication materials for internal and external stakeholders.
● Contribute to building systems, processes, and institutional capabilities that enable programs to scale and create sustained impact.

3. Desired skills

● Strong program and project management skills with an ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
● Excellent analytical, research, and problem-solving abilities.
● Strong written and verbal communication skills.
● Ability to structure ambiguous problems and develop practical solutions.
● Strong stakeholder management and relationship-building skills.
● High degree of ownership, initiative, and attention to detail.
● Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with diverse teams.
● Comfort working in a fast-paced, evolving environment where responsibilities may span strategy and execution.
● An interest in NationBuilding, public impact, and issues relevant to India's long-term development.

4. Eligibility criteria

● Bachelor's or Master's degree from a recognised institution. Candidates from diverse academic backgrounds are encouraged to apply.
● Relevant experience in program management, consulting, research, public policy, social impact, education, healthcare, science, industry, or related fields will be an advantage.
● Demonstrated experience of taking projects or initiatives from conception to execution.
● Strong academic or professional track record.
● Candidates with a demonstrated interest in contributing to India's development and solving complex societal challenges are encouraged to apply.

5. Role benefits

● Competitive compensation aligned with industry standards and experience.
● Reimbursements will be provided in line with organisational travel policies.
● Comprehensive medical insurance coverage as per organisational policy.
● Opportunity to work on initiatives with the potential to create meaningful impact in India
● Exposure to leaders, practitioners, researchers, policymakers, institutions, and organisations across sectors.
● A high-learning environment with scope to build capabilities in strategy, program management, research, stakeholder engagement, and execution.
● Opportunity to work closely with ambitious young people and contribute to developing the next generation of changemakers.

6. Role location

This is a full-time, in-office role based in Gurugram, Haryana. The role may involve travel for program activities, institutional engagements, meetings, and other initiatives as required.

Identify opportunities to simplify, standardise and scale Talent Management processes.
Ensure consistency across the organisation while recognising local business and market requirements.

Translate leadership expectations into practical development journeys and interventions.
Support leadership development across different levels, including emerging leaders, people managers and senior leaders.
Connect leadership development with assessment, talent reviews, succession and development planning.
Identify opportunities to strengthen manager capability and leadership effectiveness.

5. Talent Assessment & Development Tools:

Support leaders and HR teams in interpreting and effectively using talent data.

Use data to identify trends, risks and opportunities and support evidence-based talent decisions.
Measure the effectiveness and impact of Talent Management interventions.

Support initiatives that strengthen career development and internal mobility.
Connect career pathways and development opportunities with Talent Reviews and succession planning.
Identify opportunities to improve visibility of career opportunities and development pathways.
Support talent movement and development across functions, businesses and geographies.

Contribute to talent mapping, critical talent identification, leadership alignment, succession considerations and integration of Talent Management processes.
Support the development of talent solutions that respond to a rapidly changing and scaling organisation.

Build strong relationships with senior stakeholders and influence without formal authority.
Drive adoption of Talent Management processes through effective communication, facilitation and change management.
Challenge existing practices constructively and bring new ideas and external best practices into the organisation.
Prepare compelling leadership presentations, insights and recommendations.

Manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining quality and timelines.
Coordinate internal teams, external consultants, assessment providers, facilitators and other partners.
Establish clear measures of success and track delivery against agreed outcomes.
Bring structure, pace and accountability to complex Talent Management initiatives.

jobs.title: Lead Project Manager - Digital Technology
jobs.description:
Concentrix is looking for a Lead Project Manager to run delivery of a Planning Intelligence Platform engagement for a leading international building products manufacturer. The ideal candidate will have a proven track record of managing end-to-end digital transformation programs and business change initiatives in dynamic, high-pressure environments.

This is a delivery focused role, responsible for driving program success across multiple workstreams, ensuring alignment with business objectives, and delivering outstanding client and stakeholder outcomes. Lead Project Managers are assigned to larger and more complex engagements, often including multiple concurrent workstreams for the same client that together form a programme of work. Lead PMs provide governance and stability across all workstreams — sometimes running phases sequentially, sometimes overlapping them to hit a shared deadline — while potentially managing their own workstream directly..

Who We Are
Concentrix is the experience design and engineering team of Concentrix, a leading global solutions company that reimagines everything CX through strategy, talent and technology. We combine human-centred design, data and technology to accelerate CX transformation at scale. For more information, visit concentrix.com or connect with us on LinkedIn.

Key Responsibilities
Programme Management: Take ownership of a key client account, working closely with senior stakeholders to lead delivery of a programme of work, and establishing an appropriate layer of governance with partners and clients.
Concurrent Workstream Delivery: Where a programme has multiple workstreams, manage deliberate overlap between them — starting one workstream as soon as the one before it produces enough to work from — to hit shared deadlines without treating every plan as strictly sequential.
Project Leadership: Steer projects to successful outcomes for clients, their customers and Concentrix by providing leadership, direction and focus to project team members and clients alike.
Project Delivery: Work with the project team to ensure successful delivery end to end, from discovery through to delivery, monitoring scope and progress throughout and ensuring contractual obligations and sign-off criteria are met.
Agile Consulting: Provide coaching, mentoring and consulting for internal team members and clients on agile mindset, best practices and methodologies.
Structured Technology & Vendor Governance: Where an engagement involves evaluating technology or vendor options, keep the process honest — score options against the client's own ranked criteria (e.g. a balanced scorecard) and capture the reasoning in a decision register.
Project Scheduling: Document and manage all identified milestones, tasks and dependencies required to deliver the project, updating the plan as things change.
Project Budgets: Manage project effort burndowns and forecasts, balanced with utilisation and billability reporting.
Project Scope: Work with the team to define requirements and monitor progress, staying alert to contractual obligations and gatekeeping output against Concentrix standards.
Project Reporting: Provide timely updates to team members and stakeholders — stand-ups, status reports and budget tracking — with an explicit confidence level on early-stage artefacts, tightening as the engagement progresses. Communicate invoice-impacting changes to Finance.
Delivery Performance Reporting: Track and monitor progress and performance across projects and programmes, using agile metrics for visibility and aligned expectations.
Project Initiation & Closure: Complete initiation and closure activities, including handover to Support where relevant, profitability analysis with Finance, handover to Sales, and sharing lessons learned.
Facilitation: Proactively schedule, plan and facilitate meaningful meetings with internal and external stakeholders.
Resourcing: Ensure the right team members are assigned to all projects, while staying flexible to the broader needs of Concentrix.
Relationship Management: Maintain a professional working relationship with clients and their stakeholders, holding them accountable as you would your own project team.
Risk Management: Identify risks and issues that threaten project success and proactively manage them, escalating when appropriate.
Change Management: Carefully manage deviations from commercial agreements, working with Sales to issue change requests.
Mentoring & Training: Support the wider organisation in improving delivery standards and upskilling in project delivery methodologies.
Team & Line Management: Manage Project Management team members who report to you, supporting their goals and career progression.
Presales: Participate in and facilitate estimation sessions, coordinate estimate gathering with the delivery team and BDM, and ensure timely collation of estimates into the Commercial Review Pack and SOWs.
Process Improvement: Explore better ways of delivering projects, sharing knowledge with local and global peers and improving Project Management team processes.

Additional Skills
In addition to the key responsibilities, Lead Project Managers are expected to demonstrate proficiency in two or more of the following:
Requirements Analysis: Translate project scope into meaningful backlog items; liaise with SMEs to document requirements and determine priority, impact and value.
Analytics: Evaluate data from analytics tools and identify opportunities for it to inform decision-making.
Usability Research & Testing: Support the Experience Design team in user interviews and research, with strong note-taking and observation skills.
Strategy: Support product vision, roadmap and business case development, including presenting to a board-level audience.
Account Management: Support the Sales team in recognising and developing new opportunities.

What We're Looking For
8+ years' experience in project or delivery management, ideally including enterprise clients across a range of industries.
Experience running multi-workstream engagements, including phases that overlap rather than run strictly sequentially.
Comfortable operating in ambiguity, including engagements that start with discovery rather than a fixed spec.
Experience managing phased commercial structures (separately priced and approved phases) is a plus.
Exposure to structured, vendor-neutral technology evaluation (e.g. balanced scorecards, decision registers) is a plus, not a requirement.

Ready to lead projects that make a real impact?
Bring your expertise, leadership and delivery experience to a role where you’ll shape outcomes, influence stakeholders and make things happen. Take the lead and apply now.

Summary

Goldbelt C6, LLC., is seeking a Research Analysts (Subject Matter Expert) to support The Office of Policy, Planning, and Resources for Public Diplomacy and Public Affairs Research and Evaluation Unit (R/PPR/REU)The Office of Policy, Planning, and Resources for Public Diplomacy and Public Affairs Research and Evaluation Unit (R/PPR/REU). The Research Analysts will provide research services to support the work of public diplomacy practitioners focused on countering adversarial propaganda (CAP).

Responsibilities

Essential Job Functions:

Identify, test and advise on the procurement of digital and social media analytic and research platforms.
Develop recommendations for new or enhanced policies, processes, technologies, analytic tools, and information-related capabilities.
Assist in conceptualizing analysis and research products that are actionable by field practitioners.
Support the development, review, coordination, and implementation of policies, strategies, plans, concepts, and guidance.
Provide technical direction, mentoring, and quality assurance to junior and mid-level analysts.
Analyze foreign propaganda, misinformation, disinformation, and coordinated influence campaigns conducted through social media and other digital platforms.
Evaluate how foreign governments, state-sponsored organizations, terrorist groups, and other malign actors use social media and digital communications to influence public opinion and targeted audiences.
Provide context, data and expertise in advance of Bureau Principals' engagement with U.S. government interagency partners, foreign government counterparts, Congress, the private sector, academia, and civil society.
Conduct network analyses to map to visualize and understands social and bot networks that spread propaganda.
Conduct netnography studies, thematic analysis and multi-modal analysis to identify and understand emerging narratives.

Participate in the design of synchronous and asynchronous training for non-expert staff.
Draft materials, guides and references for non-expert staff.

Identify and utilize industry standard open-source databases and tools.

Approach problems analytically and holistically, considering the individual problem and the impact on the larger system.

Four or more years' experience with performance monitoring, performance measurement, and performance management for large-scale initiatives or for organizational-wide objectives, including developing performance indicators, establishing data collection business processes, creating data management practices, creating monitoring reports, and designing continuous improvement initiatives. The Global Technology division manages the critical systems and platforms that form the backbone of the company's retail, commercial and institutional businesses, as well as key support functions around the world.

We develop and deploy leading-edge technology in areas such as mobile and online banking, payments processing, technology infrastructure, cyber-security, risk and capital management and enterprise data management. Our mainframe environment is the third largest in the world.

Global Technology teams remain on the cutting edge of innovative learning through our focus on immersive technology. We were the first financial institution to offer a comprehensive set of tools leveraging technology like virtual reality, artificial intelligence and practice simulations within our financial centers. As a member of our team, you will use leading technology solutions and integrated platforms to ensure that our customers and clients can effectively manage their finances and bank with us anytime, anywhere.

Our Global Technology Summer Analyst Program provide you with a unique experience based on your interests, development opportunities and current business needs. Analyst positions support teams that work on the latest technology and emerging technical trends.

Our Program

The Summer program is a 10-week program designed to provide Summer Analysts with a unique opportunity to gain an exposure to life at Bank of America and also make significant contributions to the team. The Summer program begins with an in person week long orientation and induction to the firm with networking opportunities. To prepare you for your Summer internship, you will attend an in-person, week-long orientation where you will receive Bank/Line of Business information and network with peers and Enterprise leaders across Summer Campus programs. Summer Analysts are given a true associate experience, as assignments mirror full-time responsibility and include goal setting and a formal review process.

Although the role you take on may vary, every intern will have the opportunity for robust learning through trainings, professional development, networking events, volunteer activities, speaker series, and more! During your 10 weeks with Bank of America, you’ll strengthen your key skills and competencies to help jump start your career and make a real impact on our business from day one.

What We Offer

Direct placement internships give interns the opportunity to sit directly on a team working on real-time, business-critical needs. Each internship includes a unique individual internship project designed to provide real-world experience.
Formalized approach to establishing goals and expectations for the summer through our performance development process
Peer and mentor relationships that provide ongoing coaching and development feedback
Connections with senior leaders through educational speaker events
A focus on developing networking skills through connections intern-specific engagement events
Personalized Cohort Program Managers to help you navigate your internship
A welcoming company culture, including opportunities to join Employee Networks with ongoing activities for engagement and connection

Education:

Considered candidates are required to be pursuing an undergraduate or master’s degree from an accredited college or university. Eligible candidates must have a graduation timeframe between November 2027 and August 2028.

Degree Type: Bachelor’s Degree or Master’s degree
Considered candidates should be in their penultimate year of school
Masters candidates should not have more than 0 years of experience

Graduation Dates: November 2027 – August 2028
Major/Course of Study: Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Systems, or similar degree of relevance
GPA: 3.5 minimum GPA preferred

Candidates for our Global Technology programs should possess:

Fundamental knowledge and understanding of programming languages, data visualization tools, application frameworks, distributed systems and databases
Ability to deal with ambiguity, including various work assignments and changing priorities
Strong influencing skills with the ability to influence both vertically and horizontally
Assertiveness, initiative, leadership, strong work ethic and a team attitude
Distinguished written and oral communications skills
Candidates should possess a high level of intellectual curiosity, a drive for excellence, and a commitment to achieving sustainable results. Additionally, students should hold strong academic and technical skills in Microsoft Office as well as show proficiencies in leadership, teamwork, problem solving, analytical skills, verbal and written communication, and professionalism

Our recruitment process:

Analyst internship and full-time recruiting takes place on a rolling basis once our applications are open until the applications close. Assessments often begin before the deadline, so it's best to submit your application early as this will give you the best chance of being considered for the role.

Cybersecurity Analyst

At Bank of America, we make the necessary investments in our people and technologies to keep our clients’ information secure and maintain their trust, including more than $1B invested in cybersecurity alone. We protect the data of one of the world’s largest financial institutions and its more than 200,000 employees and more than 67 million consumers comprised of every individual, small- and middle-market business, and large corporation we serve, across every product and service we offer in the U.S. and more than 35 countries. In order to support these critical financial operations that span the globe, our teams operate around the clock and around the world to identify, prevent and mitigate information security risks. For all roles, teams are assigned mid-spring. Doing so offers the ability to assign program participants to real-time, business-critical needs.

Key tasks and responsibilities may include, but are not limited to
:

Providing analytical, strategic, and technical skills to design, develop, implement, and use state-of-the-art technology cybersecurity solutions aimed at reducing risk
Being responsible for delivering innovative capabilities in team environment, as well as leveraging skills, background, and interests for a specific group within Bank of America
Responding to, researching, measuring, detecting, and mitigating security attacks that attempt to compromise at the network and application layers
Working on problems of moderate scope where analysis of situation or data requires a review of identifiable factors
Being responsible for global incident management and event management processes
Supporting to produce metrics to track remediation activities
Supporting aspects of Information Security including the development of strategy and policy; vulnerability identification and management; monitoring, detecting, and responding to cybersecurity incidents

Recommended Skillsets
:

Coursework in Cybersecurity, Networking, Information Systems, and/or Programming
Knowledge of industry trends and current threat landscape
Demonstrated ability to analyze and correlate information from a wide variety of enterprise technologies
Interest in working in a global team of industry leading cybersecurity experts across multiple cyber domains
Practical understanding of core cyber security principles
Display clear motivation for exploring a cyber security, technology career within financial services
Demonstrate capacity for innovative thinking and strong problem solving
Demonstrate effective communication and interpersonal skills, and ability to interact with a variety of people
Display evidence of strong teamwork, leadership, and the ability to work in a fast-paced environment

jobs.description:
Established in 2004, Red Money Sdn Bhd is incorporated in Malaysia.

A global leader in the financial markets media industry for 20 years, we've recently launched a groundbreaking and greatly-in-demand, new platform for the global investment industry, and are seeking strong, intelligent, enthusiastic individuals to join us on this journey.

The Islamic investment industry is a fast-growing and dynamic sector within the Islamic finance space, with a ballooning pool of assets under management, reflecting a rapidly increasing demand for Islamic investment products. Yet this increased demand has not been matched by increased activity in the media space. IFN Investor, the new platform under the globally renowned IFN brand, is changing the landscape with a one stop editorial and data portal for all those involved or interested in the local, regional, and global Shariah compliant investment market. Additionally, IFN Investor, the platform, is accompanied by a series of leading IFN Investor events in the core markets.

In joining this team, you'd be responsible for managing a growing global selection of the Islamic finance industry's leading financial institutions, intermediaries and regulators, from Kuala Lumpur to London and Dubai to New York. You would ensure the accuracy, consistency, and timely availability of this data on our platform, while supporting insights and reporting that highlight market trends across both the buy- and sell-side.

So, if you want to be an integral part of this rapidly growing new team, within an already world-leading media company, we want you.

As a Financial Data & Market Intelligence Analyst, your primary responsibility is to analyze financial data, maintain a comprehensive database of Islamic funds and investment products, and actively engage with fund managers and industry participants to gather market intelligence, verify information, and identify developments across the Islamic asset management industry.

Salary range: RM 3000 - RM 3500

Key Responsibilities:
Data Collection & Management

•Source and maintain financial data on public and private investment funds from multiple markets.
•Track newly launched funds and update the database on a regular basis.
•Manage fund records with high accuracy, ensuring data consistency and compliance with defined standards.

Data Cleaning & Upload

•Clean, validate, and prepare raw data for integration into backend systems.
•Perform quality checks to identify and correct errors (e.g., formatting issues, duplicate entries, missing values).
•Handle bulk uploads into the database backend, ensuring smooth publishing to the website.
Analysis & Reporting
•Conduct regular analysis on the funds market (excluding restricted regions as assigned).
•Use tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or Excel to generate dashboards, reports, and insights.
•Provide weekly and quarterly summaries of market developments to support internal and external stakeholders.

Collaboration & Support

•Work closely with clients across regions to maintain coverage of 2,500+ global Islamic funds.
•Support the editorial and marketing team in preparing datasets and materials for publications, client reports, and events.
•Contribute to the continuous improvement of processes, tools, and workflows.
Client Engagement & Market Intelligence
•Build and maintain relationships with fund managers, asset management companies, and industry participants within assigned markets
•Conduct regular check-in calls and meetings with fund managers to obtain the latest fund updates, market developments, product launches, and industry insights.
•Gather exclusive market intelligence and identify emerging trends, opportunities, and stories that many not be publicly available.
•Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned fund managers, ensuring data accuracy through direct engagement and verification.
•Proactively identify missing or outdated information and follow up with relevant stakeholders to maintain database quality
•Contribute market commentary and insights gathered from industry interactions to support research, editorial content, events, and business development initiatives.

Requirements:

•Bachelor’s degree in finance, economics, statistics or IT.
•Strong financial acumen and a deep understanding of financial markets.
•Strong proficiency in Excel (advanced functions, data cleaning, pivot tables).
•Experience with data visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI, or similar).
•Knowledge of databases/SQL is a plus.
•High attention to detail and accuracy in handling large datasets.
•Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
•Ability to manage multiple deadlines and work independently.
•Applicants should be Malaysian citizens or hold relevant residence status.

Interested applicants are invited to submit a CV including contact number, date available and current and expected salary to humanresource@redmoneygroup.com

Job Description:

Reporting to the Manager of Cybersecurity, the Third-Party & Trust Center Analyst sits at the intersection of vendor risk management and customer-facing security assurance. This role is responsible for assessing the security, privacy, and compliance posture of third parties across the vendor lifecycle, while also owning and maintaining the company’s Trust Center: the centralized hub of security documentation, certifications, and due diligence materials used to build confidence and trust with customers and prospects. The role incorporates controls from a variety of security and privacy frameworks (e.g., ISO, NIST, HIPAA, PCI DSS) and is regularly updated to address emerging industry and regulatory risks.

Key Responsibilities:

Third-Party Risk Management

• Assess third parties and vendors globally for compliance with contractual agreements, security
requirements, industry best practices, and regulatory obligations.
• Gather all relevant information for each engagement: type of engagement, data in scope, data flows, connectivity to internal networks, and intended data use; and evaluate impact to security objectives.
• Raise information requests where vendor or business responses are incomplete, and maintain accurate, comprehensive assessment records in an online GRC/TPRM platform (e.g., OneTrust).
• Proactively identify gaps or conflicts in existing processes and drive remediation of control deficiencies identified during assessments.
• Monitor assessment timelines, vendor record expiry dates, and reassessment cadences to keep the third-party risk register current.
• Assess potential business changes (new engagements, scope changes, offboarding) for impact to third-party compliance obligations.

Trust Center & Customer Assurance

• Maintain the Elsevier’s Trust Center, curating and publishing customer-facing security documentation: certifications, policies, whitepapers, product details, and FAQs; to accelerate customer due diligence.
• Respond to inbound customer and prospect security questionnaires (e.g., SIG, CAIQ, custom RFP/RFI security sections), partnering with sales, legal, product owner(s), and security to deliver accurate, timely responses.
• Support internal and external audit inquiries related to third-party risk, Trust Center content, and customer due diligence requests.
• Serve as a trusted point of contact for customers and prospects seeking assurance on Elsevier’s security and compliance posture.
Governance & Stakeholder Engagement

• Build strong relationships with business partners (Legal, Procurement, Privacy, and Product teams) and vendors; facilitate continuous improvement aligned with operational processes.
• Contribute to the maturation of processes governing third-party risk, data classification, and data handling requirements.
• Manage day-to-day communication with stakeholders and vendors, escalating concerns, queries, or issues to security leadership as appropriate, including suggested service and process improvements.
• Support metrics, KPIs, and executive-level reporting on third-party risk posture and Trust Center
engagement to support risk-based decision making.

Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in Information Security, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
• 2 – 3 years of experience in information security compliance, third-party/vendor risk management, or IT audit.
• Basic technical knowledge across security domains, including infrastructure security and its impact on security operations, vulnerabilities, reporting, analytics, and monitoring.
• Working knowledge of security and privacy standards and audit frameworks such as ISO 27001/27017, ISO 27701/27018, HIPAA, PCI DSS, and NIST 800-53.
• Experience with GRC/TPRM and trust center tooling (e.g., OneTrust, SafeBase, Optro (formerly AuditBoard) or similar platforms).
• Ability to interpret data flow diagrams and evaluate data privacy and data protection implications of third-party engagements.
• Excellent communication skills: able to explain complex or detailed compliance requirements clearly and concisely at all levels of the business and to external customers, and to keep leadership updated on progress and escalate issues promptly.
• A ‘can-do’ attitude and enthusiasm that inspires others; well organized and efficient, with the ability to multi-task and meet tight deadlines.
• Ability to work effectively and supportively within a global, cross-functional team.
• Willingness to receive training, mentoring, and ongoing support.
• Experience assessing vendors against security and privacy control frameworks and managing large control sets.
• Experience handling inquiries from customer security questionnaires and maintaining a trust center.
• Fluency in English required.
• Preferred certifications: CISSP, CISA, CISM, Security+, or ISO 27001 Lead Auditor/Implementer.

Working across website analytics, marketing automation, CRM, paid media, and social platforms, you will transform complex, multi-source data into actionable insights that help marketing leaders make informed strategic decisions. This is a highly visible role that combines hands-on analytics expertise with strategic influence, helping establish reporting standards, improve data governance, and create a single source of truth for marketing performance.

Key Responsibilities

Design, build, and maintain dashboards and reporting frameworks that consolidate data across Google Analytics, Salesforce, Pardot, paid advertising, social media, and other marketing platforms.
Analyze campaign, channel, funnel, pipeline, and ROI performance to identify trends, opportunities, and recommendations for optimization.
Translate complex, multi-source data into clear insights and business recommendations for marketing and executive stakeholders.
Establish and maintain KPI definitions, reporting standards, data governance practices, and attribution methodologies across marketing systems.
Partner closely with Marketing, Marketing Operations, Sales Operations, IT, and Web teams to ensure data quality, reporting consistency, and alignment between marketing activities and business outcomes.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Analytics, Statistics, Business, Data Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
5+ years of experience in marketing analytics, digital analytics, business intelligence, or a related data analysis role, preferably within a B2B environment.
Hands-on experience with Google Analytics (GA4), Salesforce CRM, and Pardot or a comparable marketing automation platform.
Proven experience developing dashboards and reports using Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or similar business intelligence tools.
Strong SQL skills and experience working with large, complex datasets from multiple sources.
Demonstrated ability to communicate technical findings and data-driven insights to non-technical stakeholders.
Experience measuring marketing attribution, lead lifecycle performance, pipeline influence, and campaign ROI.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to work in a fast-paced, global environment while managing multiple priorities.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience within a technology, semiconductor, manufacturing, or industrial B2B organization.

Experience establishing reporting governance frameworks, KPI standards, or analytics centers of excellence.
Experience with or understanding of SEO and GEO/AEO (Generative/Answer Engine Optimization) measurement, including tracking visibility across AI-powered search and answer platforms.
Working knowledge of ETL processes, data integration concepts, and marketing data warehousing solutions.

jobs.title: Assoc. Program Manager, Activity Management
jobs.description:
Job Description

The Activity Management Associate is responsible for providing strategic oversight for education activities and managing a broad variety of duties involved with planning, developing, implementing, and evaluating educational activities, including both face-to-face and online formats, for the American College of Cardiology (ACC). Activity Managers partner with healthcare professionals, internal colleagues, and external partners to successfully implement activities in compliance with relevant regulatory requirements.

Responsibilities

Liaise with product or grant manager to intake activity requirements and provide implementation status updates
Lead the team of staff and vendors implementing educational activities using proven project management strategies
Develop and manage activity timelines, ensuring milestones are reached according to schedule
Schedule and facilitate internal team and faculty meetings, including the development of agendas and meeting minutes that are shared with relevant stakeholders and maintained in planning files
Partner and coordinate with internal stakeholders across multiple divisions and departments relevant to the goals and format of the activity (e.g., Instructional Design, Logistics, Marketing, Communications, Member Strategy, IT AV Collaboration & Events, Education Measurement & Analysis, etc.) to ensure successful and efficient activity implementation
Partner with activity leadership, faculty, and fellow staff to ensure development of needs-based, measurable educational content through the:
Use of appropriate sources and data to identify key clinical and/or non-clinical problems and the associated practice gaps that should be addressed through the activity
Development of learning objectives, identification of desired outcomes, and agenda for activities
Integration of an activity design that incorporates teaching strategies appropriate for the adult learner
Implementation of activity assessment strategy designed to measure outcomes

Develop, distribute, collect, and maintain faculty invitations and ensure required documentation is completed, serving as the primary liaison to faculty throughout implementation
Procure primary source material; ensuring all necessary elements are received and properly processed, including content, photographs, permission(s), disclosure information, graphics, and references.
Coordinate with logistics staff to plan and implement activities, and to ensure effective and fully integrated learning design that carries through to venue
Collaborate with Marketing and Branding to facilitate the development of marketing plans and materials that will support achievement of participation goals
Develop and/or coordinate materials for distribution to learners
Monitor the financial status of assigned activities, including recommending areas for managing revenue and expenses
Provide onsite team leadership and support for faculty and assist, as needed, with other logistics
Ensure compliance with and documentation of accreditation policies and procedures (e.g., ACCME, ANCC, etc.)
Keep current on standards and guidance in the medical education field that impact activity development and management
Implement best practices in continuing education, including researching and sharing innovative ideas for potential integration into the development and delivery of activities
Other responsibilities as assigned

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree
4+ years of demonstrated experience in project management and/or development of educational activities
At least two years of experience working in a team environment with internal and external constituencies
Experience managing multiple large-scale (200+ attendees, concurrent sessions), national meetings simultaneously
Experience managing online delivery of educational activities through a Learning Management System, and/or online platform
Strong interpersonal skills that support teaming with a broad array of stakeholders, including medical professionals, executive leaders, contractors, consultants, partners, and internal colleagues
Demonstrated ability to organize complex projects and be attentive to details that will influence the success of a project
Ability to manage multiple educational activities and associated tasks simultaneously, set priorities, and maintain timelines
Familiarity with developing and monitoring budgets and expenditures
Excellent critical thinking and problem-solving skills
Strong oral and written communication skills necessary to interface with relevant stakeholders
Strong copyediting and proofreading skills
Intermediate proficiency in MS Office (i.e., Outlook, Word, Excel and PowerPoint) and Adobe Professional
Knowledge of industry standards and guidelines related to certified medical education
Knowledge of instructional design principles and aligned adult learning strategies
Requirement to periodically work outside of standard work hours to meet deadlines, including the publishing of news from scientific meetings
Ability to travel both in support of job responsibilities and for professional development (anticipated at 10% or less of time annually; may be up to one week at a time and includes weekend travel)

Desired

Activity management experience in the medical education field
Project management certification or credential
Experience using constituent engagement and management software (e.g., Personify, Salesforce)
Experience with timeline management software (e.g., Microsoft Project)

About Us

At the American College of Cardiology, we bring our hearts to work.

We are a 500-person organization dedicated and committed to our mission to transform cardiovascular care and improve heart health for all for more than 75 years. When you join our team, you become part of a culture that envisions a world where science, innovation and knowledge optimize cardiovascular care and outcomes.

Every day, we are committed to supporting our more than 60,000 members and their patients around the globe and in doing so, ensure our staff have a positive environment of teamwork, collaboration, professionalism and excellence. To learn more about why ACC has been recognized as a great place to work, please visit our site, www.acc.org/jobs .

What We Offer

ACC values all members of our College family, including ACC staff. As the foundation of the organization, ACC staff enjoy world-class benefits and a culture of work-life balance. Our benefit offerings include insurance (medical, dental, vision, basic life, and short- and long-term disability, and supplemental options), generous paid time off (pre-loaded vacation and sick, 12 holidays and an organizational shut-down during the last week of the year, parental leave, 2 community service days, and half-day summer Fridays), tuition assistance and a very competitive 10% retirement contribution after a year of service, and much more! You can visit our careers site for an overview of our full offerings. Please note that these offerings may change at any time.

ACC believes in fair and equitable pay. Multiple factors are taken into consideration when we determine what salary to offer a selected candidate. These factors include, but are not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the role, the selected candidate’s work experience, education and training, as well as internal equity, market, and business considerations. Our salary ranges differ based on the cost of labor in the local market where the job will be performed.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Bidgely (which means "electricity" in Hindi) is a Vertical AI company built for the utility industry, delivering appliance-level intelligence for every customer, grid asset, and hour of the year through our UtilityAI™ Platform. We're accelerating a clean energy future by giving utilities and their customers the ability to make smarter, data-driven energy decisions.

Bidgely's platform is connected to 38M+ meters across 45+ utility deployments and is backed by over 20 patents. Our approach combines patented disaggregation science, generative AI for natural-language insight, and agentic AI for autonomous operations — giving utilities a level of individual-customer intelligence and grid insights that horizontal AI and legacy analytics platforms can't match.

Bidgely has been named #7 in Applied AI on Fast Company's list of Most Innovative Companies in the World and recognized as a Utility Analytics Leader by Guidehouse.

What We Do

Powered by our unique patented technology, Bidgely's UtilityAI™ Platform transforms multiple dimensions of utility data — such as energy consumption, demographics, and customer interactions — into deeply accurate and actionable consumer energy insights. We leverage these insights to empower each customer with personalized recommendations tailored to their individual personality and lifestyle, usage attributes, behavioral patterns, purchase propensity and beyond.

The same technology that powers Bidgely's customer suite also enables a set of powerful grid applications. From a distributed energy resources (DER) and grid edge perspective, Bidgely is accelerating utility innovation with data-driven solutions for solar PVs, electric vehicle (EV) detection, EV behavioral load shifting and managed charging, load forecasting, grid analytics, and rate designs. Bidgely's UtilityAI™ energy analytics platform provides deep visibility into generation and consumption for better peak load shaping and grid planning and delivers targeted recommendations for new value-added products and services.

How You Fit In

The Senior Technical Program Manager (STPM) owns Bidgely's largest and most technically and commercially complex utility engagements, combining the roles of technical consultant, functional consultant, and project manager. The STPM also acts as a delivery and practice leader for the broader Customer Onboarding team. The STPM works closely with a dedicated delivery team on the technical build, with R&D and Product Management on platform direction, and with Systems Integrator partners on multi-party engagements — while owning the customer relationship, executive stakeholder management, and program outcomes. The STPM reports into the Director, Customer Onboarding and is part of Bidgely's Customer Onboarding team.

Core responsibilities span the following areas:

Project Management

Be the face of Bidgely for the customer during the implementation phase, owning the relationship, and being an advocate for them internally
Manage Bidgely's largest and most complex utility implementations end to end from Onboarding to Launch, leading cross-functional teams across Delivery, Engineering, Product, and Sales
Oversee project financials — including cost tracking, budget, and margin — for assigned engagements
Contribute to contract reviews for new deals and change orders
Represent the Onboarding team in sales presentations as needed
Develop and apply a deep understanding of energy markets and customer behaviors to help Bidgely customers take full advantage of the technology

Technology Implementation

Own the overall solution design and development for Bidgely's most complex utility customers, working with our global engineering team — including requirement analysis, customer journey scope discussion, data integration, design, solution architecture, implementation, delivery, and customer-facing technical issue resolution
Be the product expert who collaborates with utility customers to understand requirements, map them to product features, and finalize product customizations and changes
Manage project deliverables, ensuring on-time, high-quality delivery through a hands-on approach
Produce technical and product documents that clearly define customer requirements and solution design in collaboration with the customer's IT and business teams
Partner with Bidgely R&D and Product Management to design new platform functionality and implementation tooling, informed by patterns observed across the most complex customer implementations

Practice Leadership

Mentor and provide delivery and technical guidance to colleagues
Own executive-level customer relationships for high-visibility engagements
Develop proposals and statements of work for new and expanding engagements
Identify and help scope account expansion opportunities during delivery
Represent Customer Onboarding in quarterly business reviews (QBRs)
Work with Systems Integrator (SI) partners to plan and execute complex, multi-party implementations
Train Bidgely, SI, and customer teams on Bidgely's project methodology and product capabilities
Develop internal tools and processes that improve delivery quality and reduce implementation timelines
Support hiring and interviewing for the broader TPM team

Skills And Qualifications

Required Qualifications

7-11 years of software integration project experience at a SaaS company, or experience in a top-tier systems integration consulting firm and/or delivering enterprise solutions at a fast-paced start-up
Track record of successfully delivering complex, cross-functional implementations for large, high-touch enterprise customers, ideally with ACV of $500K+
Experience as the primary point of contact for enterprise customers, including designing and deploying solution architecture in a customer-facing role
Experience working with globally dispersed customers and teams
Experience with Agile software development methodologies and cloud-based B2B implementations
Comfortable creating and tracking project plans, risks, and status reports via Wrike, Smartsheets, Jira, or similar cloud project management tools
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with excellent written and verbal communication and the ability to translate complex technical issues for non-technical stakeholders
Demonstrated ability to mentor and develop less experienced team members
Highly organized, collaborative, and proactive, with a customer-first mentality

Preferred Qualifications

Working knowledge of SQL, Python, REST APIs, or data transformation tools, with a hands-on aptitude for applying them directly
Passion for or experience within the energy or energy efficiency sector
PMP certification

What You Get

Growth Potential: Build your career at a fast-scaling company at the forefront of AI-driven energy innovation
Collaborative Environment: Work with a passionate team united by the goal of a clean energy future
Leading Technology: Gain hands-on exposure to the AI, machine learning, and data platforms shaping the future of the utility industry

Benefits

Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance from day one
HSA, FSA, and DCFSA plans
401(k) plan
Flexible paid time off
Annual wellness stipend
Annual professional development stipend
Paid parental leave
Mental health and wellness resources for you and your family

Other Perks

Employee Discounts: Preferred pricing on entertainment, technology, and insurance products
Mentorship: Access to mentorship from experienced industry leaders
Flexible Work Arrangements: Remote-friendly scheduling built around how you work best
Community Service Days: Paid time to volunteer for causes you care about

Location

Remote within the US with up to 15% travel

Salary And Compensation

The base salary ranges from $135,000-$160,000 DOE. This role may also be eligible for a discretionary annual bonus and equity, subject to company policy and role level.

In accordance with the California Equal Pay and Pay Transparency laws, the approximate annual base compensation range is listed above. The actual offer, reflecting the total compensation package and benefits, will be determined by a number of factors including the applicant's experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity among our team.

Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Equal Opportunity

At Bidgely we're on a mission to make a difference and build a workplace where every unique voice is heard and celebrated. Here, we believe that celebrating the unique backgrounds, perspectives and abilities of every employee makes an impact not only for our company internally but also for our clients, customers and community.

We are an equal opportunity employer and believe that the inclusive atmosphere we build together will enable every person to grow, contribute and thrive. Our hiring decisions are based on your skills, talent, and passion – not on your background, gender, race, age, or the quirky way you dance at office parties.

Atos ist die Marke der Atos Group für KI-gestützte, sichere und ganzheitliche digitale Services. So unterstützt Atos öffentliche und private Organisationen weltweit dabei, die Kontrolle über ihre Daten und IT-Infrastrukturen zu bewahren und gleichzeitig regulatorische Anforderungen zu erfüllen.

Mit mehr als 54.000 Mitarbeitenden betreut Atos über 4.500 Kunden in 54 Ländern, und unterstützt sie bei der Modernisierung ihrer zentralen IT-Systeme, der Beschleunigung ihrer Cloud- und Datentransformation, der Stärkung ihrer Cybersicherheit sowie der Bereitstellung sicherer digitaler Arbeitsplatzlösungen – zum Nutzen seiner Kunden, ihrer Mitarbeitenden und der Gesellschaft. Darüber hinaus bietet Atos unter der Marke Atos Amplify Beratungsleistungen an.

Als vertrauenswürdiger Partner beim Betrieb komplexer und geschäftskritischer Umgebungen unterstützt Atos Organisationen in stark regulierten und souveränen Kontexten.

Über die Atos Group

Die Atos Group ist ein weltweit führender Anbieter im Bereich der digitalen Transformation. Mit ca. 56.000 Mitarbeitenden und einem Jahresumsatz von ca. 7,2 Mrd. EUR (auf Basis des künftigen Unternehmenszuschnitts) agiert das Unternehmen in 54 Ländern unter zwei Marken Atos für Services und Eviden für Produkte und Systeme. Als europäische Nummer eins in der Cybersicherheit und führend im Bereich Cloud arbeitet die Atos Group für eine sichere und dekarbonisierte Zukunft und bietet maßgeschneiderte KI-gestützte End-to-End Lösungen für alle Branchen. Atos Group ist an der Euronext Paris notiert.

Wir suchen neue Kolleg innen an unseren bundesweiten Standorten.

Als Project Manager verantwortest Du die vertragliche und fachliche Führung unserer SAP-Public-Cloud-Projekte und steuerst unsere internationalen Projektteams. In dieser Rolle bist Du verantwortlich für das Erreichen der Projektziele, den Projekterfolg und die Zufriedenheit unserer Kunden.

Das sind Deine Aufgaben

Du trägst die unternehmerische Verantwortung für die fachliche Führung großer SAP-Projekte im Bereich S/4HANA Cloud, Public Edition und unterstützt und begleitest den Kunden bei der Einführung der SAP-Standard-Prozesse und Best-Practice
Du führst fachlich die Projektteams oder Teilprojekte in einem Multiprojekt-Umfeld
Du verantwortest das Erreichen der Projektziele in Zeit, Budget und Qualität, den Projekterfolg und die Zufriedenheit des Kunden
Planung, Leitung und Ressourcensteuerung sowie Monitoring des Projektfortschritts, Erstellung von Statusberichten, Prüfung und laufende Überwachung definierter Projektkennzahlen in allen Phasen des Projektes sowie die Dokumentation vorhandener Projektergebnisse und -erfahrungen, Nachbetrachtung und / oder Lessons Learned zu Projektabschluss gehören ebenfalls zu Deinen Aufgaben
Zudem coachst Du die Beteiligten im Projekt hinsichtlich der Anwendung von Projektmanagementprozessen und Methoden
Auch in der Kundenakquise und bei Presales-Aktivitäten (Angebotserstellung, Sales Pitches, Ausschreibungen, Messen) ist Deine Unterstützung und Expertise gefragt
Du erweiterst beständig Dein Fachwissen, bildest Junioren aus und trägst damit zum Wissenstransfer in unserer Organisation bei

Das bringst Du mit

Abgeschlossenes Studium in der Fachrichtung Betriebswirtschaft, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Informatik oder vergleichbare praktische Erfahrung
Du verfügst über mindestens 6 Jahre Erfahrung im klassischen SAP-Projektgeschäft und besitzt eine PMP- Zertifizierung oder Vergleichbares
Du verfügst über erste Projektmanagementerfahrung in der SAP S/4HANA Cloud, Public Edition (idealerweise mit entsprechender Zertifizierung)
